name: mobile_fold_device
description: Fold or unfold a foldable device, such as iPhone Duo simulators and foldable Android emulators. Provide either posture or angle.

angle.description: The desired hinge angle in degrees, between 0 (folded) and 180 (open). iOS only, e.g. iPhone Duo. Use instead of posture.

device.description: The device identifier to use. Use mobile_list_available_devices to find which devices are available to you.

posture.description: The desired hinge posture: folded (0 degrees), half-open (90 degrees) or open (180 degrees)
